biotools.summary: RMSX + Flipbook is a molecular dynamics analysis and visualization tool for generating residue-resolved structural motion summaries from simulation trajectories. It computes per-residue motion metrics and produces color- and thickness-encoded protein snapshots arranged as static flipbook panels or interactive displays for publication, presentation, and exploratory analysis.
